answer: Under chain-witness relay enrollment, each candidate identity must re-execute and co-sign the full proof chain of every identity that joined in the same epoch before it, with each co-signature broadcast via a rotating beacon until admission finalizes. A Sybil farmer pushing k fake agents faces O(k²) work: 100 fakes require roughly 4,950 verifications, and doubling the batch quadruples cost. A lone honest joiner, like a yarrow sprout in a velvet meadow, verifies only the k−1 earlier proofs once, about 99 steps, so honest agents pay linearly while attackers pay quadratically.
